title: SYNTHLA-EDU: Synthetic Learning Analytics Data Generation Pipeline
summary: A pipeline that processes the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) and generates synthetic educational datasets, then evaluates them for ML utility, statistical quality, and privacy risk. It fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer via sdv.single_table, using SingleTableMetadata and SDMetrics' QualityReport to score the synthetic outputs.
evidence: oulad_synthetic_analysis.py:49-52 fits GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer from sdv.single_table; QualityReport from sdmetrics run for evaluation
